messages:
incident-bot: DETECTED: 12:23 UTC — surge of overage flags for customer cohort eu-* in billing pipeline. token_count_delta > threshold. paging oncall sreevan.

sreevan (oncall): on it. seeing ~2.3k overage flags in last 5m. does this map to any deploy? @maria can you check emitter/collector? :pager:

maria (billing-eng): no deploys in billing this hour. quick check: shard-emitter eu-2 shows delayed ack and backlog. logs show repeated `emit_retry` and `heartbeat_missed`.

owen (sre-lead): @sreevan -> can you run a quick shadow vs canonical tally to confirm drift? if shadow is ahead then emit duplication possible.

sreevan (oncall): running quick query... output:
```
select sum(tokens) from shadow_ledger where minute >= now()-interval '10 minutes';
 => 1,842,312
select sum(tokens) from canonical_ledger where minute >= now()-interval '10 minutes';
 => 1,004,875
```
So shadow is ~83% higher. This looks like duplication at emitter side.

maria (billing-eng): confirmed. correlation id shows emitter replays: `emitter_id=eu-2 attempt=3` repeated. Investigating consumer dedupe logic; consumer sees unique_id missing on some messages.

kai (support): any customer-facing impact? Support dashboard shows several customers received overage alerts in last 30m (ticket spike). I'm drafting a short note.

alex (product): please include expected ETA and mitigation steps for comms. Focus on high-revenue tenants first.

sreevan (oncall): mitigation plan: (1) pause shadow ingest for eu-2 to stop double counting (doable via /ops/disable-emitter eu-2-shadow) (2) enable quick dedupe filter on consumer (hotfix) (3) backfill reconciliation for affected window.

owen (sre-lead): thumbs up. @maria coordinate hotfix. I'll take pause command. Executing: `/ops/disable-emitter eu-2-shadow` -> success, shadow emitter paused.

maria (billing-eng): working on consumer-side filter, pushing a small change to skip messages without `unique_id` and to ignore replays where `attempt>1`. Rolling canary now to 3 consumers.

incident-bot: ACTIONS: incident created INC-2026-452, pager escalated to eng-billing. Runbook: billing-drift -> follow.

kai (support): comms draft: "We detected anomalous billing signals causing temporary overage alerts for some customers in EU region. We're mitigating and will provide update within 30 minutes." ok to send?

alex (product): send to impacted customers list with priority tag. include refund/credit pledge.

sreevan (oncall): monitoring metrics: tokens_emitted, dedupe_hits. initial dedupe filter reduced replays by ~78% in canary consumers. overage alerts rate down 70%.

maria (billing-eng): hotfix promoted to 100% at 12:45 UTC. planning reconciliation and credits calculation. will open billing-recon PR with steps.

owen (sre-lead): after-action tasks: capture root cause (emitter retry storm due to transient kafka lag), add better idempotency enforcement at emitter, add alert to detect shadow/canonical divergence >20%.

sreevan (oncall): closing pager for now, but keeping thread open for recon work. last update: customers notified, hotfix live, shadow paused. ETA for reconciliation numbers: 6 hours.

kai (support): thanks. I'll file follow-up tickets and update support queue.

maria (billing-eng): adding initial credit estimate to INC-2026-452 comment. will share final numbers when reconciliation done.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigating -> customers_notify=true -> next_update=12:55 UTC
